maddeler.e:
استدركن (form X)
# اِسْتَدْرَكْنَ (istadrakna) /is.tad.rak.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
# اُسْتُدْرِكْنَ (ustudrikna) /us.tud.rik.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
# اِسْتَدْرِكْنَ (istadrikna) /is.tad.rik.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
